title: U.S. Forces Launch Operation Epic Fury

title: U.S. Defends, Disables Threats in Response to Iranian Aggression

title: U.S. Defends, Disables Threats in Response to Iranian Aggression

title: U.S. Forces Complete Latest Strikes in Iran

title: U.S. Forces Finish Latest Round of Strikes Against Iran
